findings.description: At 360 px wide the expenses table is clipped (its wrapper uses overflow: clip, and the page does not scroll horizontally), so the Amount column is cut off and cannot be reached on a phone. The total is still shown, but the individual amounts are not visible.
repro: Sign in as viewer-b0ae at a 360 px wide viewport
Observe the table: the Category column is cut off at the right edge and the Amount column is not visible; no horizontal scroll is available

findings.description: At 360 px wide the editor's table is clipped the same way: the Amount and Actions columns (Edit and Delete links/buttons) are off-screen and cannot be scrolled to, so editors on a phone cannot edit or delete expenses from the list.
repro: Sign in as editor-39c2 at a 360 px wide viewport
Observe that the Amount and Actions columns are cut off; there is no way to scroll the table horizontally to reach Edit or Delete

findings.description: Every row's Delete button has the same bare name 'Delete' with no expense title, and the Edit links are likewise all named 'Edit', so screen-reader users navigating by buttons or links cannot tell which expense each control affects.
repro: Sign in as editor-39c2 at 1280 px
List the buttons or links by accessible name: nine buttons are named 'Delete' and nine links are named 'Edit' with no row context

notes: Tested: login for both roles, totals and category filters (correct), viewer blocked from add/edit pages (Forbidden), add and edit saves (totals updated correctly; I added a test expense 'QA test item' and changed Notebooks to $20.00 in the shared data). Delete flow not tested. Keyboard focus is visible (3px outline on Apply). Not tested: contrast measurement, full keyboard traversal, tablet widths.

cost.notes: estimate from 25135 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0003-$0.0030
